title: Routing, Middleware, and Request Handling
hints: Prefer PSR-7 request and response objects for HTTP behavior.
Middleware is registered in Configuration/RequestMiddlewares.php per request scope, with before and after naming other middleware. Keep each one focused and its position deliberate.
Avoid global state when request-scoped data is available.
This applies to HTTP only. A console command is not a request handler, whatever its class name suggests.
